RagaM-Roll — raga notations

Auto-detected Carnatic raga notations (arohana/avarohana). Audio is not hosted here. Open a raga in pitchy — it draws the roll and plays the detected notes; use its on-page prompt to download the original recording from ragasurabhi and upload it to hear the source. draw shows the roll only. Drafts from a native pitch-detection pipeline — expect rough spots; ⚠ check Sa marks likely tonic/octave issues.
